name: Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV)

programs.title: High school diploma (or equivalent) recognized by Spanish authorities
Proof of Spanish or English proficiency (depending on program language)
Pre-university qualification process (UNEDasiss) for non-EU students
Bachelor’s degree in a related field
Proof of English or Spanish proficiency
Additional documents such as a motivation letter, CV, and reference letters may be required
Applications typically open in March and close in July for the September intake
Non-EU applicants are advised to begin the process earlier due to document legalization timelines

description: Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV) is one of Spain’s leading public technical universities, consistently ranked among the top technological institutions in Europe. Located in the coastal city of Valencia, UPV combines academic excellence with cutting-edge research and strong industry links. It is particularly renowned for engineering, architecture, and technology-related fields.
